results.title: Early Career & Campus Recruiter
results.description: About Us We are AMS. We are a talent solutions business. Working with clients across the globe, we have learned what it takes to be a high performing employer. It starts with talent; sourcing, selecting and keeping the right people in the right jobs. To do this well, you need unmatched expertise in digital innovation, and a deep understanding of the complex needs of the talent you are seeking to engage - whether that talent is external to your business or already inside it. Taking a holistic approach to the HR value chain and to attracting and retaining a world class workforce enables business success. 10,000+ experts, across 120+ countries, speaking more than 50 languages, delivering projects for the world’s most admired companies. We are AMS. This is what we do. Talent is our world. The RoleThe Recruiter will support client hiring managers with filling their campus / early careers hiring demand. They are responsible for ensuring all quality thresholds and SLA/KPIs are met. The role includes planning and executing campus recruitment activities, managing stakeholder relationships, and delivering excellent recruitment services to the client in line with agreed service levels, acting as the custodian of candidate quality and the hiring manager experience, working in conjunction with onsite and offshore campus colleagues. The Recruiter will work closely with the Team Lead (TL), Manager (CSM), Senior Manager (SM) recruiters & coordinators to ensure high-quality recruitment services and a smooth recruitment process. Reports to EC&C Team Lead / Manager / Senior Manager. This role will require someone to be able to go onsite to the New York location at least 3 days a week. The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $100,000 per year. Key AccountabilitiesWill be required to be onsite at the client 3 days a week at the New York office.Responsible for preparing and scheduling interviews using assessment centers and Webex links between candidates, hiring managers and recruiters for first and final round interviews (Superday’s).Uses existing Bank of America campus processes and systems (HireVue, Workday, Oleeo (as applicable)).Create and publish Campus programs in Oleeo.Preparing and generating Offers to candidates.Participation in local events as needed. Skills & ExperienceBachelor’s degree preferred0-2 years’ experience in human resources, client services, sales, marketing, recruiting or communications in a corporate environment preferred. Internship experience welcome.Problem solver, proactive, organized, and resourcefulThrives in an ambiguous environment and has the ability to manage changing priorities while meeting deadlinesExcellent verbal & written communication skillsStrong Microsoft office skills (Outlook, Excel &PowerPoint).The ability to work as a team player who is comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic, flexible and collaborative work environmentDemonstrates a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of workExcellent organization and communication skills, and experience of presenting to senior clients/stakeholdersAbility to prioritize and manage a varied workload, and exercise sound judgmentHigh level of initiative and self-motivation, resilience and ability to deal with ambiguity OtherWe're a fast-growing, equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or disability. Please let us know of any reasonable adjustments or accommodations you require during the recruitment process by emailing our team at talentacquisition.generalenquiries@weareams.com

results.title: Recruiter
results.description: Position Title: Recruiter Location: Ogden, UTAnticipated Start Date: ASAP.Expected Duration: 06 months contract.Job Type: Contract role/40 hours a Week/Onsite. Summary of what they are looking for: This person will be doing full cycle recruiting for direct labor positions, primarily machinists. Recruiter will be responsible for screening resumes, call candidates, do brief initial phone screens, schedule interviews, participate in interviews, be the primary focal point for candidates and keep in touch with them as they move through the process. Recruiter may extend offers and coordinate pre-employment steps.Looking for someone very detailed and able to keep things rolling. Need to be professional, well-spoken and comfortable calling candidates.Very high-volume recruiting. Will be working on 40 direct labor roles that need to be filled quickly. Key Responsibilities:- Manage the full recruitment cycle including posting job ads, screening resumes, contacting applicants, conducting phone and in-person interviews, and coordinating hiring efforts with department managers.- Act as the focal point for all candidates throughout the recruitment process, responding quickly to questions from candidates- Coordinate pre-employment steps with candidates such as pre-employment drug screens and background checks through our third-party vendors- Provide regular updates and reports to HR team and leadership on recruitment status.- Update and maintain the applicant flow log with candidate status- Maintain accurate and up-to-date recruitment records using our HRIS system. Qualifications:- High School diploma required, BS degree in HR or a related field preferred.- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in manufacturing or a similar industrial setting.- Strong understanding of recruitment processes and candidate selection methods.- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to engage effectively with candidates and internal stakeholders.- Proficiency in using HR software and candidate databases.- Ability to handle multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

results.title: Corporate Recruiter
results.description: Our Recruiter II position is responsible for attracting, engaging, and hiring the best talent for assigned functions, business groups or manufacturing facilities. The role involves sourcing and prescreening candidates, scheduling phone screens, on-site interviews, coordinating pre-employment activities and owning the talent pipeline for assigned areas, among other responsibilities. The Recruiter II will report directly to the Talent Acquisition Manager and work closely with the Leadership Team JOB RESPONSIBILITIES: Recruit for assigned functional areas including [insert level of position, i.e. plant, intern, salaried] positions.Source and prescreen candidates following process on candidate discussion documentation.Schedule phone screens and on-site interviews for candidates including coordination with interview teams, company resources, and travel department.Conduct relative internet research as requested to support projects and program initiatives.Coordinate pre-employment activities and post-hire documentation.Make recommendations for sourcing strategy including external recruitment and social media sites.Manage confidential and personal identification information.“Own” the talent pipeline for assigned areas and serve as the subject matter expert.Participant in onsite or offsite Recruitment events and job fairs.Identify, schedule, and represent the company at local and state community events to promote careers in manufacturing.Actively participate and network with associations, social networks, and sales/marketing groups to build a network of candidates on an on-going basis.Ensure proper documentation meets compliance of the recruitment process.Meet the defined expectations for the Affirmative Action Plan and the associated data requirements.Provide timely reports to Managers and Directors.Act as an informal mentor; teach techniques and strategies of recruiting to recruiters and recruiting coordinator.In alignment with business goals and leadership, aid in developing effective solutions to address skills gaps and culture integration.Provide the assigned business team with coaching on recruitment best practices. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Associates Degree or equivalent experience2 years HR related experience or progressive work experience in full-cycle recruitment PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s DegreeExperience working in Human Resources fieldExperience working with an applicant tracking system KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Demonstrated flexibility Ability to work within a fast-paced, growing and dynamic environmentSolid communication skills, verbal and writtenHighly organized and detail orientedAbility to challenge the status quo and willing to “roll up the sleeves and get things done” with a “can do” attitudeAdvanced proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

results.title: Human Resources Intern

results.title: Human Resources Summer 2024 Internship
results.description: Northmarq – Minneapolis, MN (Bloomington, MN) At Northmarq, you can be part of something special. Northmarq is a unique capital markets resource for commercial real estate investors, providing our clients access to experts in debt, equity, investment sales, loan servicing, and fund management. We offer you a career path with best-in-class training, and we foster inclusive teams committed to collaboration, mentoring, and growth. At Northmarq, we will help you unlock your potential – whether you are an industry veteran or you’re just getting started. Your new career is waiting. Start something special today. Northmarq was voted by Real Estate Forum as one of The Best Places to Work in Commercial Real Estate! Northmarq is offering a Human Resources Internship at their Minneapolis, MN (Bloomington, MN) headquarters office. This position will be responsible for overall Human Resources assistance. The intern will work in all areas of Human Resources (including but not limited to; Compensation and Benefits, Recruiting, Wellness, and Event Planning) to aid the team in the successful completion of projects. The intern will develop professionally and gain practical HR experience while completing challenging, significant work. The position requires strong communication skills and experience with Microsoft Suite skills. Updates and audits various HR databases including Company websites internal and external. Performs HR customer service functions by answering employee’s requests and questions. Processes, organizes, and streamlines files and documents Participates in special projects for other departments as needed in line with department goals and objectives. Maintains compliance with federal and state regulations concerning employment, including, but not limited to ADA, FLSA, and FMLA. Human Resources degree preferred but not required Office experience preferred Strong computer knowledge and skills, including in-depth expert knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) Problem-solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems promptly and gathers and analyzes information skillfully Interpersonal Skills—the individual maintains confidentiality, remains open to others’ ideas, and exhibits a willingness to try new things. Oral communication—the individual speaks clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, demonstrates group presentation skills, and conducts meetings. Planning/organizing—the individual prioritizes and plans work activities, uses time efficiently, and develops realistic action plans. Quality control—the individual demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors their work to ensure quality.
